Dry run: apply a mapping version to every row of this import and report counts per

get.description:
The import's field profile (DI-06): per-column observations and read-only
suggestions. Values are masked by each column's classification; nothing is changed.

post.description:
Validate the import with its usable ACTIVE mapping version, once (D-21): it is pinned,
every row is accepted (a canonical record), quarantined or rejected, and the import ends
COMPLETED, COMPLETED_WITH_WARNINGS, QUARANTINED or FAILED (a file-level BLOCKER: no row
accepted). 409 `mapping_required` without a usable mapping version, 409
`already_validated` on a second call: a re-run is a new import.

get.description: Mappings by code; filter by source and target schema.

A mapping for a source contract with DRAFT version 1, pinned to the target schema's
ACTIVE version (D-18).

get.description: The mapping with every version and its rules.

post.description:
The next DRAFT version, pinned to the target schema's ACTIVE version now. Earlier
versions are never edited.

APPROVE activates the version and deprecates the previous ACTIVE one; REJECT ends
it (a comment is required). The author cannot decide (403 self_approval).

DRAFT -> IN_REVIEW. The author only; needs an ok dry run of this version (409
mapping_validation_required otherwise).

get.description:
A batch's quarantined and rejected rows (D-20), by row, with their values masked by
classification. Nothing here is ever deleted.

post.description:
Move an item along the D-20 table (audited). No row is deleted or edited; a
correction is a new import with retry_of_import_id.
